messages:
Olivia: Quick sync — post-launch telemetry mostly stable but we've got a new tail: a low-rate memory leak in long sessions and a pile of UX/helpdesk asks. Need to pick sprint mix for the next two weeks: hotfix vs experiment (A/B) vs split.
Sam: Can we get impact numbers? how many customers affected, repro rate?
Jun: Leak shows up after ~6k tokens in very long chats. Observed in 2 large customers, repro ~1.2% of long sessions, causes reconnects.
Mike: Repro in prod is flaky. I can add heap sampling and a synthetic load harness but needs ~2 days.
Kate: Design thinks an A/B of the new composer (smaller scope) could reduce tickets by surfacing clearer errors — quick win if infra supports metrics.
Olivia: Options: (A) Hotfix-first (70/30 hotfix:experiment) (B) Balanced 50/50 (C) Experiment-first 40/60. Tradeoffs: hotfix reduces regressions fast but touches runtime; experiment gives visibility and may reduce tickets without risky deploys.
Sam: Hotfix estimate? rollback risk?
Jun: Root cause investigation + patch ~4 dev days, 1 day integration + simple canary. Rollback straightforward if we feature-flag.
Mike: I can ship the profiler/harness in 2 days (heap-dump + smoke job). That will speed debugging a lot.
qa-bot: CI update: added 'stream-leak-synth' nightly job to catch long-session regressions. ETA: 24h to validate.
Ops: If hotfix touches runtime, we need a maintenance cadence and on-call coverage for the ramp.
Olivia: Proposal: sprint 1 = 60/40 hotfix:experiment. Sprint 2 = finish experiment + hotspots/cleanup. Rationale: reduce customer-facing errors quickly while still delivering visible product changes.
Sam: I'll own rollback/playbook and schedule ops coverage; can start D2. Watch windows need to be explicit.
Kate: We'll scope the A/B to 5% traffic initially, metric funnel: completion rate and ticket inflow. Can deliver mocks + metric sheet by D3.
CS: Customers want a staging canary and a short ETA. I'll consolidate asks and offer a dedicated window for biggest customer.
Olivia: Action owners (summary): Jun — hotfix prototype & patch (D1–D4); Mike — profiler + harness (D1–D2); Sam — rollback playbook, ops coord (start D2); Kate — experiment design + metric tracking (D1–D3); qa-bot — monitor and run smoke job. CS — customer comms.
Mike: Also adding heap-size and minor GC telemetry flag for the canary build. Will gate logs behind a feature flag.
Jun: Need a small schema addition to store leak traces (one-off, low risk) — can we greenlight?
Sam: Approve the schema change, but let's keep it behind a temp flag and purge after triage.
Ops: Requested on-call coverage D7–D10 for canary ramp. Confirmed but note infra patch scheduled on D6 — avoid conflict.
Olivia: Good catch — shift canary to start D7 to avoid infra patch.
Kate: A/B dashboards + mock delivered by D3.
CS: I'll prepare the customer note with ETA and rollback guarantees once we finalize canary criteria.
Olivia: Proposed canary criteria for hotfix: local repro -> PR -> canary 5% for 24h with synthetic load and GC/heap telemetry showing no regressions -> ramp 25% for 48h -> target leak <0.2% and no spike in error rates. Rollback if leak >0.5% or error rate >1%.
Mike: Will add telemetry flags and a small structured log to help postmortem if needed.
Jun: No other blockers from my side. Need CI harness to reproduce before merging.
qa-bot: Confirmed harness queued; will report results tomorrow morning.
Olivia: Any objections to the plan?
Sam: None.
Jun: Fine.
Mike: Good to go.
Kate: Go ahead.
CS: OK — I'll offer customers the D7 canary window and weekly updates.
Olivia: Great — I'll file sprint cards, tag owners, and post the plan to stakeholders. Thanks all :rocket:
